rows: Equipment: Overcurrent protection device (50/51), SPAJ 140C, ABB
Issued to: New Assiut Power Station
Procedure: Test using the Sverker 650 test set

sections_en.text: This document sets out the test and calibration steps for the overcurrent protection device, as shown above. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Faisal at the Assiut Thermal Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the field test was carried out on 06 April 2003 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Faisal.

items: Isolate the circuit breaker whose breaker failure protection is to be tested, and also isolate the breaker's two disconnectors
Open an approved work order and provide the industrial safety category card for the workers
Fence off the work area and place the necessary warning signs
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment
AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOKOGAWA

sections_en.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out

rows: Place Test plug type RTXH 18 in Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay (50/51)
Short points (65, 17B) at the back of the relay (50/51)
Inject current at points (3, 4) in the Test plug to test phase R until the signal appears
Record the current value for phase R
Inject current at points (5,6) in the Test plug to test phase S until the signal appears
Record the current value for phase S
Inject current at points (7,8) in the Test plug to test phase T until the signal appears
Record the current value for phase T
Remove the short from points (65,17B) at the back of the relay (50/51)

Connect the Stop terminals of the current injection set to points (65,1A), where 1A in the Test plug connects to the negative (-) terminal of the injection set, and 65 at the back of the relay (50/51) connects to the positive (+) terminal of the injection set
Inject current of value (1.2 x In) at points (3, 4) in the Test plug to test Time delay t1
Record the time value, Time delay t1

Connect the Stop terminals of the current injection set to points (77,78) at the back of the relay, where 78 at the back of the relay (50/51) connects to the negative (-) terminal of the injection set, and 77 at the back of the relay (50/51) connects to the positive (+) terminal of the injection set
Inject current of value (5 x In) at points (3, 4) in the Test plug to test Time delay t2
Record the time value, Time delay t2
Reset the Lock Out Relay of the relay (50/51)
Remove Test plug type RTXH from Test socket type RTXP on the relay (50/51)

text_en:
Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Protection – Generation | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: OCR-028-r0a | Equipment: Overcurrent protection device (50/51), SPAJ 140C, ABB
Issued to: New Assiut Power Station
Status: APPROVED
Approval date: 06 April 2003 | Procedure: Test using the Sverker 650 test set
Next review date: April 2008
Introduction
This document sets out the test and calibration steps for the overcurrent protection device, as shown above. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Faisal at the Assiut Thermal Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the field test was carried out on 06 April 2003 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Faisal.
Safety Precautions
Isolate the circuit breaker whose breaker failure protection is to be tested, and also isolate the breaker's two disconnectors
Open an approved work order and provide the industrial safety category card for the workers
Fence off the work area and place the necessary warning signs
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
SVERKER 650 current injection set
AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOKOGAWA
Test comb, type RTXH 18
Test leads
Work Steps to be Carried Out
Place Test plug type RTXH 18 in Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay (50/51) | 1
Short points (65, 17B) at the back of the relay (50/51) | 2
Inject current at points (3, 4) in the Test plug to test phase R until the signal appears | 3
Record the current value for phase R | 4
Disconnect the injection set | 5
Inject current at points (5,6) in the Test plug to test phase S until the signal appears | 6
Record the current value for phase S | 7
Disconnect the injection set | 8
Inject current at points (7,8) in the Test plug to test phase T until the signal appears | 9
Record the current value for phase T | 10
Disconnect the injection set | 11
Remove the short from points (65,17B) at the back of the relay (50/51) | 12
Connect the Stop terminals of the current injection set to points (65,1A), where 1A in the Test plug connects to the negative (-) terminal of the injection set, and 65 at the back of the relay (50/51) connects to the positive (+) terminal of the injection set | 13
Inject current of value (1.2 x In) at points (3, 4) in the Test plug to test Time delay t1 | 14
Disconnect the injection set | 15
Reset the timer | 16
Connect the current injection set | 17
Record the time value, Time delay t1 | 18
Disconnect the current injection set | 19
Connect the Stop terminals of the current injection set to points (77,78) at the back of the relay, where 78 at the back of the relay (50/51) connects to the negative (-) terminal of the injection set, and 77 at the back of the relay (50/51) connects to the positive (+) terminal of the injection set | 20
Inject current of value (5 x In) at points (3, 4) in the Test plug to test Time delay t2 | 21
Disconnect the injection set | 22
Reset the timer | 23
Connect the current injection set | 24
Record the time value, Time delay t2 | 25
Disconnect the current injection set | 26
Reset the relay (50/51) | 27
Reset the Lock Out Relay of the relay (50/51) | 28
Remove Test plug type RTXH from Test socket type RTXP on the relay (50/51) | 29
